art, or read a two-arm tool-description\n rewrite experiment\n cancel [options] Cancel an i
n-flight eval run (no-op if already\n cancelled; errors if it already finished)\n rerun [options] <ru
n-id> Rerun a finished eval run's failed cases as a new\n run. The platform picks the cases: any wit
h a trial\n that did not complete and pass (cancelled and\n skipped trials
do not count)\n judge-backtest [options] Preview draft grading instructions on recorded\n evidence
(uses credits)\n backtest [options] Preview assertion changes on stored evidence\n without c
hanging results\n judge [options] Grade a finished eval run with LLM as Judge (SPENDS\n yo
ur model budget)\n github Run an eval suite on a GitHub repository's pull\n reque
sts (GitHub checks)\n checks Deprecated alias for `cloud eval github` — a\n repos
itory's GitHub checks, not a case's grading\n checks\n iterations [options] List per-iteration
results for an eval run\n (pass/fail, tool calls, tokens, latency)\n gate [options] Apply
a pass/fail policy to a finished eval run and\n set an exit code (0 pass or waived, 1 eval failure,\n
2 usage, 3 incomplete)\n compare [options] Compare a finished eval run against a baseline a

nd
 set an exit code (0 pass, 1 regression, 2 usage, 3
 incomplete)
 v
alidate [options] Validate a local eval suite file offline — no auth,\n no network unless --pr
oject is passed (0 valid, 1\n contract-invalid or unresolved reference, 2\n
unreadable/oversize/malformed)\n export [options] Write a hosted eval suite to a local suite file,\n
refusing anything it cannot represent losslessly\n pull [options] LEGACY: materialize a hosted eval suite
into a\n corpus lock for @mcpjam/vitest — new work should\n use `eval exp
ort` (0 clean, 1 drift under --frozen,\n 2 usage, 3 incomplete)\n trace [options] Fetch th
e full trace for one eval iteration (large:\n full message history + spans)\n steps [options]
Per-authored-step results for one eval iteration:\n status (ok/fail/skipped/pending), reason, and\
n evidence (screenshot/video URLs). The fastest way\n to see WHICH step fa
iled and why.\n screenshot [options] Show the widget screenshot(s) an eval iteration\n rendered
— inline when the terminal supports it,\n otherwise the image URL\n video [options] Get t
he replay recording an eval iteration made —\n prints the URL, or downloads it with --out. A local\n
widget run records a .webm; an unattended run on a\n hosted browser records
an .mp4\n get [options] Show an eval suite's full settings\n update [options] Edit an eval suite's setti
ngs (only the flags you\n pass change)\n delete [options] Permanently delete an eval suite
(and its cases and\n runs)\n schedule [options] Enable or disable scheduled runs for a suite\
n environments Attach or detach the project environments an eval\n suite runs against\n
cases List, author, and edit an eval suite's test cases\n help [command] display help for comm
and\n", "exit_code": 0, "status": "completed"}}
